forbidden_inferences.description: Attribution of an observed change to the project or intervention.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: A bounded spectral comparison does not identify causation.

forbidden_inferences.description: Estimation or validation of carbon abatement or storage quantity.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: NDVI is not a carbon-accounting measurement or model.

forbidden_inferences.description: Determination that outcomes would not have occurred otherwise.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: The PoC has no counterfactual design.

forbidden_inferences.description: Judgment about ACCU validity, quality or integrity.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: Credit assurance requires evidence and authority beyond a bounded observation.

forbidden_inferences.description: Determination of regulatory or methodology compliance.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: The PoC is not a regulator or compliance audit.

forbidden_inferences.description: Determination that an environmental outcome is permanent.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: A two-window comparison cannot establish persistence or permanence.

forbidden_inferences.description: General project-performance conclusion beyond the declared observable.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: Authority is limited to the frozen AOI and temporal comparison.
The PoC does not perform legal analysis or determine liability.

forbidden_inferences.description: Investment, lending, purchase or trading recommendation.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: Observational evidence qualification is not financial advice.

forbidden_inferences.description: Determination that a project or credit is ready for tokenisation.
forbidden_inferences.outside_authority_reason: Tokenisation suitability is outside the evidence and authority scope.
